# Page Composition Blueprint Gate

**Sprint:** P0.JURNL.F09-SAFE-TO-SPEND.COMPOSITION-BLUEPRINT-RENDER-OWNERSHIP-CORRECTION1
**Source of truth:** `shared/studioos-visual-authority/hybrid-authority.ts`. `PAGE_COMPOSITION_BLUEPRINT_GATE.json` is generated by `npx tsx scripts/studioos/visual-authority-export.ts`.

> **THE METAPHOR MAY DEFINE A SIGNATURE OBJECT OR ZONE. IT SHOULD NOT AUTOMATICALLY DEFINE THE ENTIRE PAGE.**

## Why it exists

The creative-direction layer settled what a territory means and how the brand should feel. Nothing settled how the page is composed. Every generation had to guess the page architecture, the hierarchy, the UI geometry, where the brand sits, the navigation, the type and the signature object. Twice, the guess turned the metaphor into the whole page and squeezed the product into it.

A blueprint is that composition, written down as geometry before any generation.

## Where it sits

```
STRUCTURAL TERRITORY → CREATIVE DIRECTION (04A) → BRAND EXPRESSION (04B)
→ PAGE COMPOSITION BLUEPRINT (04C · BLUEPRINT_READY)
→ RENDER-LAYER OWNERSHIP (04D · OWNERSHIP_READY)
→ ART PLATES → DETERMINISTIC ASSEMBLY → COMPOSITE AUTHORITY (05) → FOUNDER REVIEW
```

## What a blueprint holds

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `frame` | Page size in pt, the generated aspect, and how the plate maps to the viewport |
| `safe_areas` | Top inset, bottom inset, stage x / width, top of the nav reserve |
| `metaphor_scope` + justification | OBJECT · ZONE · ENVIRONMENT · BACKGROUND · INTERACTION · WHOLE_PAGE. WHOLE_PAGE needs a recorded founder decision. |
| `layers_present` | Which of L0–L8 the page uses |
| `zones` | Role, layer, rect, and slots. Each slot has precision kinds (EXACT_COPY, FINANCIAL_VALUE, LOGO_GEOMETRY…), content or a data binding, and DECIDED or an open founder-decision id. |
| `overlap_relationships` | Every allowed intersection between product zones, and how it works |
| `depth_order` · `visual_focal_order` | Back-to-front layers; what the eye reads first (always the primary signal) |
| `scroll_behavior` · `responsive_logic` · `density_intent` | NO_SCROLL or ATOMIC_PAGINATION; what scales and what never does; how rich versus quiet the page should be |

Required zone roles: SYSTEM_CHROME, BRAND_FRAME, PRIMARY_SIGNAL, SIGNATURE_OBJECT, SECONDARY_PRODUCT, CTA, NAV, ENVIRONMENT, PERIMETER, NEGATIVE_SPACE.

## Checks (`checkCompositionBlueprint`)

1. Every required zone role is present.
2. Every zone is inside the frame and on a declared layer.
3. Product and signature zones never collide with the status bar, chrome or nav.
4. Product zones intersect only through a declared relationship.
5. Product zones stay inside the stage width, below the top inset and above the nav reserve.
6. The signature object is 12–50 % of the stage. Above that, the metaphor has taken the page.
7. The primary signal is centred in the upper 60 % of the frame, and the focal order starts there.
8. Product content is not crammed into one third of the frame.
9. At least 6 % of the stage is reserved, named negative space.
10. The depth order covers every layer present, and the responsive logic is stated.

Fail → `PAGE_COMPOSITION_BLUEPRINT_REQUIRED`, and no generation may start.

## First use

JURNL F09 has three blueprints at 393×852: T01 OBJECT, T02 ZONE and T03 OBJECT. See `JURNL/F09_SAFE/COMPOSITION_BLUEPRINT_CORRECTION1/`.
